verdict.rationale: Probe evidence implies irs.gov serves a content robots.txt: one probe checked a path against it, and another notes it does not govern the app host. However, the application host that runs the EIN online assistant returned HTTP 503 for robots.txt and has no stable published file, so an agent cannot learn the rules before fetching the transactional surfaces. Missing for 10: a stable robots.txt on the sa.www4.irs.gov application host, a direct fetch of the irs.gov robots.txt showing its contents, and any first-party documentation of crawl or agent policy.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the service publishes a real robots.txt, so an agent can know what it may read before fetching anything

citations.quote: /dmaf is not disallowed by irs.gov robots.txt
the irs.gov content robots.txt does not govern it
